review.admission: Exact repository/branch/push/head message, attempt 1, GitHub-hosted Linux, Node24.22.1/pnpm10.34.3, expiration, disabled caches, and driver hash; no retry command. Read-only contents token; checkout credentials not persisted.
review.reachability: Ops second parent G, G parent R, R parent M: checkout depth4 includes the required M/R/G commit objects and trees. M's encoded parents are checked; execution does not require checking them out.
review.sourceBoundaries: Independent Git metadata matches manifest SHA/tree/parents. Commit file lists show M→R only the unchanged-baseline-plus-appended PG test; R→G exactly four already-reviewed product/unit files. Runtime sourceProof checks HEAD/tree, clean index/diff, fixed file/common blob hashes, original test prefix, and reconstructed actual tracked worktree tree before and after every unit/PG phase.
review.dependencies: Exactly one frozen pnpm install into this run's temporary store. Package/lock/workspace/tsconfig/helper hashes are common across phases; no source patch or compilation-cache reuse.
review.unitEvidence: M's complete template-subscriptions file expects33 tests, G's read-batch-context file expects30. Each command runs in a separate process, records real status and complete stdout/stderr bytes/hash. Each unit catches failure independently and performs an after-source proof; failure does not skip the other unit or PG but prevents final exit0.
review.databaseIsolation: Fresh owned PostgreSQL17 container with random masked password, only 127.0.0.1:5432 published, exact run/attempt/commit labels and private network. All three DB URLs must match the generated disposable mikka_e2e endpoint, with no external legacy fallback.
review.freshPhases: RED begins with no schema_migrations. GREEN drops/recreates mikka_e2e via a separate control database, requires a different database OID and empty schema, and reruns migration/bootstrap/setup. Only job-created bootstrap_<32hex> databases outside the initial catalog may be removed.
review.redPredicate: Requires code1, exactly25 tests/22pass/3fail/zero skipped-todo-cancelled. Exactly two named leaf ERR_ASSERTION/testCodeFailure records with specified message and actual/expected5/1 and4/2, plus exactly the named subtestsFailed parent. Timeout/signal/spawn errors never qualify.
review.greenPredicate: Requires code0, exactly25 tests, no TAP failures/skips/todo/cancellation, pass==tests via the independently read fixed checkSummary implementation; both target names must occur.
review.failureContinuation: Each PG phase has its own catch/finally; unknown RED failure invalidates proof but GREEN is still attempted against a fresh DB. All-source/summary failures persist independently. Overall exit0 requires both complete units and exact RED plus full GREEN.
review.originals: Every settled command's original stdout/stderr is credential-screened, written as bytes with SHA256/length and status, and also encoded in bounded log chunks. No transcript truncation is applied by the controller. Receipt persists after each command/unit/phase. Output containing temporary credentials blocks export rather than silently altering originals.
review.cleanup: Always-run cleanup after successful prepare does not depend on manifest admission still being open. It validates exact owned labels, stops/removes only this container with --volumes, verifies original anonymous volumes and container absent, removes the exact empty owned network, deletes local temporary DB/auth environment files, persists cleanup.json, and fails if cleanup fails. Artifact upload also uses always().
review.closure: Reused old workflow is statically closed with if:false. New entry remains guarded for the one admitted push; final normal closing commit must set enabled:false and disable its job after the terminal run. Closure is operationally pending, not claimed complete.

knownBoundaries: This review performs no Node/TypeScript/Docker/SQL execution and reads no Actions originals. Expected test counts are gate predicates, not observed passes.

Root independently reported candidate ops parents/tree and the G→ops three-entry-only diff. This review independently verifies the three entry blobs and M/R/G Git metadata, not the new ops tree a second time.
A killed/interrupted command may leave an incomplete execution and cannot satisfy the gate; full-output claims apply to completed commands captured by the controller.
The alternate-index proof covers actual tracked files, with fixed absence checks for the new helper on M/R. It is not a general filesystem sandbox.
Successful local PostgreSQL/unit checks do not establish the actual Native/Web query gate, production tracing, daemon cold-start/network behavior, or overall issue acceptance.
